newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle trade moderately active - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle trade moderately active - USDA.

text.p: Trade was moderately active early Wednesday, with dressed basis delivered (paid on hot carcass weights) steers and heifers steady with Tuesday, USDA said.
Dressed Basis Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1250-1325 lbs 112.50- 113.00. Dressed Basis Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1250 lbs 112.50- 113.00.
Prices not established on a live basis. Buyer inquiry and demand good. Seller interest mixed.
Slaughter Heifers - No confirmed sales. Confirmed - 2,000 For the week - 38,000.
